result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no critical defects. One minor styling inconsistency was found with the favorite (heart) icon backgrounds.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons on the restaurant cards use inconsistent background treatments. The heart on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card sits on a white circular background, while the heart on the pizza card below sits on a dark/transparent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon container background and contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
